name: Gigantes Plaki
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical Greek Gigantes Plaki recipes using ~400g beans plus 800g tomatoes yielding 4 main-dish servings
Total time sums active prep (~15 min) + bean simmer (50 min) + sauce cook (~15 min) + bake (60 min); excludes overnight soak
All ingredients plant-based per instructions and screening; no animal products listed
No gluten-containing ingredients (wheat, barley, rye) or uncertified oats listed
No dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, or soy listed
Sesame ambiguous as unspecified compound sauces or cross-contact not addressed
Parsley, oregano, cinnamon, and tomato products treated as standard without hidden allergens
Canned tomatoes and puree assumed plain without additives
instructions:
Soak the beans overnight in plenty of water. Drain, rinse, then place in a pan covered with water. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat, then simmer for approx 50 mins until slightly tender but not soft. Drain, then set aside.

Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan, tip in the onion and garlic, then cook over a medium heat for 10 mins until softened but not browned. Add the tomato purée, cook for a further min, add remaining ingredients, then simmer for 2-3 mins. Season generously, then stir in the beans. Tip into a large ovenproof dish, then bake for approximately 1 hr, uncovered and without stirring, until the beans are tender. The beans will absorb all the fabulous flavours and the sauce will thicken. Allow to cool, then scatter with parsley and drizzle with a little more olive oil to serve.

ingredients.name: Butter Beans
ingredients.assumptions: Canned butter beans, drained weight as given; typical drained canned values used

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons olive oil (standard 15 ml per tbsp converted to grams using density ~0.91 g/ml)

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium chopped onion, typical edible weight ~110 g

ingredients.name: Garlic Clove
ingredients.assumptions: 2 typical garlic cloves, total peeled weight ~6 g

ingredients.name: Tomato Puree
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons tomato puree/paste; typical weight 15 g per tbsp

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Canned chopped tomatoes with juice, full 800 g weight used as recipe lists 800 g tomatoes

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon granulated sugar; typical weight 12 g

ingredients.name: Dried Oregano
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon dried oregano; typical weight ~3-4 g, rounded to 4 g

ingredients.name: Cinnamon
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of ground cinnamon estimated at 1 g as plausible small amount

ingredients.name: Chopped Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley; typical weight ~4 g per tbsp
